candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Dimnah with its pasture lands, and Nahalal with its pasture lands: four cities.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,

wikipediaArticleCheck.title: Cities in the Book of Joshua
wikipediaArticleCheck.readEvidenceJa: 一覧表のDimnah行を実読。Joshua 21:35、Zebulun, a Levitical city、Rimmon-Methoarへの参照と同一視の疑問符がある。
wikipediaArticleCheck.profileUseJa: 名前と節の照合に限り用いる。Rimmon-Methoarとの同一性は不確実なので現代所在地・座標を導かない。

wikipediaChange.changeReasonJa: 実読した一覧行が対象のヨシュア記の地名・節に対応するためリンク追加。現代位置候補は採用せず、座標はnullを維持。
